prelude: import { Context } from "vibelang/context"; export abstract class C extends Context { abstract value(): number } const seen: number[] = []; export function snapshot() { return seen.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) }

cases.name: getter
cases.declaration: export class Resource { get value(): number { return C.context().value() } }

cases.name: setter
cases.declaration: export class Resource { set value(value: number) { seen.push(value + C.context().value()) } }
cases.body: const resource = new lib.Resource(); resource.value = 1; return lib.snapshot()

cases.name: coercion
cases.declaration: export class Resource { toString(): string { return String(C.context().value()) } }

cases.name: iterator
cases.declaration: export class Resource { [Symbol.iterator](): Iterator<number> { return [C.context().value()][Symbol.iterator]() } }
cases.body: let total = 0; for (const value of new lib.Resource()) total += value; return total

cases.name: disposal
cases.declaration: export class Resource { [Symbol.dispose](): void { seen.push(C.context().value()) } }
cases.body: { using resource = new lib.Resource() } return lib.snapshot()

cases.name: async-disposal
cases.declaration: export class Resource { async [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> { await Promise.resolve(); seen.push(C.context().value()) } }
cases.body: { await using resource = new lib.Resource() } return lib.snapshot()
